events.content:
Implemented `Dashboard` to request all three APIs in parallel with `Promise.all` and display each response. It shows loading and error states and cancels requests if the component unmounts. Browser-side fetching lets the relative `/api/...` URLs resolve correctly.

Verification passed: `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit && npm run build` and `git diff --check` (exit code 0). The checkout does not contain those API routes, so live responses could not be verified; until they exist, the component will show an error.
